data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (search, open restaurant, set date and guests, click Notify, set time and confirm) and names the right parameters, including extras like city and meal_period; it is slightly hedged by "if needed" and "optionally", and it uses preferred_end_time rather than a general time window, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
